about_the_game:
In the Great Cavern, humanity's last bastion, a fragile peace is shattered by a single intruder.

A sudden invasion by a "Nephilim," a ghost from a forgotten past. And with it, a chilling prophecy: "In 30 days, humanity will face total annihilation."

You are the "Master," the only one who can lead the "Dystopia Girls"—humanity's last hope. You must stand against a fate that seems inevitable.

■ Defy Destiny in a Repeating Timeline You have only 30 days. During this time, you will forge bonds with six unique android girls, grow stronger through perilous battles, and uncover the dark secrets of your sanctuary. But failure is not the end. A cruel fate will pull you back to the beginning, forcing you to relive the 30 days. Gather the fragments of lost memories through each time loop and discover the key to breaking this tragic cycle.

■ Key Features

  • A Time-Looping Roguelite Visual Novel: Experience a unique, story-driven roguelite where every death is a new clue. Your failures will never be in vain.

  • Six Charming Heroines: Your choices will open the hearts of six distinct girls. The deep bonds you form with them are your greatest strength and the key to unlocking the hidden truth.

  • A Fate-Defining Multi-Ending Story: The story concludes based on whose hand you hold in the final moments. Discover six individual character endings and one true ending where all secrets are revealed. How will your story end?

  • A Tale of Lies, Betrayal, and Truth: Who is an ally, and who is the enemy? Uncover your own truth at the heart of a grand conspiracy hidden behind the cause of protecting humanity.
